notes: C++ of this rule differs between binary dc8ad24031 and HEAD only cosmetically (clang-format, brace-init mkNode for deterministic node ids).

Binary predates large changes to src/rewriter/basic_rewrite_rcons.cpp and rewrite_db_proof_cons.cpp (and CPC :opaque indices, a13878bc19); 'no trust' results are for the binary's reconstruction. CPC proofs were checked with ethos against the HEAD signature in deps/cvc5/proofs/eo/cpc.

rules.dispatch: post-rewrite BITVECTOR_REPEAT via RewriteRepeat (only rule); ProofRewriteRule BV_REPEAT_ELIM registered PRE_DSL
rules.summary: (repeat n a) -> a if n=1 else (concat a ... a) n times
rules.guard_comparison: No RARE rule. Internal checker is circular (rewriteViaRule calls RepeatEliminate). The CPC rule bv-repeat-elim (proofs/eo/cpc/rules/BitVectors.eo:17) uses $bv_unfold_repeat = eo::list_repeat concat a n plus list_singleton_elim (n=1 -> a), a generic list builder independent of the C++ loop; CPC `repeat` requires a positive numeral, matching the C++ Assert(amount>=1). repeat 0 is not well-typed input.
rules.probe_result: cvc5=unsat z3=unsat for n in {1,2,5} at w1 and {1,2,3} at w3; no trust; bv-repeat-elim in proof; ethos (HEAD sig) accepts
rules.rationale: Theory rewrite whose Eunoia definition is an independent, trivial list repetition; the CPC proofs check in ethos.

rules.dispatch: post-rewrite BITVECTOR_ROTATE_LEFT via RewriteRotateLeft (only rule)
rules.summary: (rotate_left k x) -> x if k mod w = 0, else concat of two extracts
rules.guard_comparison: C++: a = amount mod w; a=0 -> x; else concat(x[w-1-a:0], x[w-1:w-a]). RARE -1: a=(mod amount n)!=0, u1=n-(1+a), u2=n-1, l2=n-a; -2: (mod amount n)=0 -> x. Identical index arithmetic; RARE uses unbounded Int amount, C++ uint32 (equal at HEAD since the parser rejects indices >= 2^32).
rules.probe_result: cvc5=unsat z3=unsat for amounts {0,1,5}@w1, {0,1,3,4,6,9}@w4, {7,4294967295}@w5 against independently computed concats; no trust; both RARE variants used; ethos accepts; old-binary artifact: RotateLeftEliminate_amount_2pow32 gives cvc5=sat (expected unsat), z3=parse error. get-value shows binary dc8ad24031 parsed the index 4294967296 as 4294967295 (stringstream saturation); the rewrite of that term is correct. HEAD (c403bf1c3e) rejects indices >= 2^32 in Smt2TermParser::tokenStrToUnsigned, so this is a fixed parser bug, not a rewrite bug
rules.rationale: The C++ case split (mod = 0 or not) maps one-to-one onto the two RARE rules with identical index arithmetic; edge amounts (0, >= width, multiples of width, 2^32-1, width 1) reconstruct without trust.
